from pathlib import Path
# print functions around softmagic source path
p=Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file/src/softmagic.c')
lines=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
for a,b in [(1,120),(320,440),(1080,1245),(1240,1310),(1820,1910)]:
 print(f'--- {a}-{b}')
 for i in range(a-1,min(b,len(lines))): print(f'{i+1}: {lines[i]}')
